Shorter subject in class_enrollment_request emails (enrollment and removal): missing

justificativa: The patch shortens only the class_enrollment subjects, and with different text from the official fix (no year/semester, no new method), while the course_class and class_enrollment_request emails still use the long class name, so the 'Data too long' error can still occur.
